change_log.weakness: The planner recommended a spoken note for 40 of 41 reels, and a picture or video for lists. The judge's best format was a card for 11 reels, a video for 9 and steps for 7.
change_log.change: Moments are chosen by the content's shape: a list is a card or steps, a method or exercise is steps or a video, a topic with parts is a map, one idea or the family's news is a note. A picture never goes alone.

change_log.weakness: Makers dropped the reel's substance for reassurance: "we can skip the computer part", a 15-term list cut to one example, 5 steps merged into one page (24 major "prompt" findings).
change_log.change: Keep the substance, simplify only the words: name every item of a list (up to 7), keep steps in order and each claim with its step, never tell her to skip a part; unconfirmed claims are the speaker's.

change_log.weakness: 9 of 41 reels were called likely scams, including an airport seat tip, a free university course and student discounts, so their moments became warnings with no content.
change_log.change: A tip, opinion, recommendation, tutorial, exaggerated marketing or "comment to get the link" is unverified, not a scam, unless a main claim is false or it asks for money, details or a risky download.

change_log.weakness: Fridge cards left "remember" empty for lists (4 cards), the one line meant to be kept.
change_log.change: remember holds the date, time, name or thing to keep; for a list, what the list is ("films to watch together").

change_log.weakness: Videos for exercises and demonstrations showed generic icons instead of the movement (17 major "tool" findings: "cannot show the mouth shape", "no visual model of the exercises").
change_log.change: The reader describes every frame (pictures_en); a video scene can set frame to show the reel's own still behind its words; the viewer shows it. One movement per scene with its cue and a safety line.

change_log.weakness: The reader summarised lists and steps loosely, so later agents had no item names to keep.
change_log.change: Facts keep each named item, each step in order and which claim goes with which step; a pasted caption is the creator's own words.

change_log.weakness: Film-clip reels carry their content in the caption (the film's title); a saved video loses it, so moments could not name the film (5 major findings on 2 reels).
change_log.change: The share box asks for the caption when a video is attached; the lab passes the caption from round 2.

change_log.weakness: The lab capped moments at three with the planner's picks first, so the profiler's content-based choice was cut (a mind map was made once in 41 reels).
change_log.change: The planner's first two, then the profiler's first choice, then the rest, at most three.

change_log.weakness: Told in words to choose by shape (C1), the planner still recommended a note (and often a picture) first: a resource list got note + picture, a vocabulary list note + picture.
change_log.change: The plan names the content's shape (list, steps, movement, topic, one idea, family news, warning); for a parent, code makes the shape's moment first (card, steps, video, map) and recommends at most two.

change_log.weakness: For misleading or unverified reels the moments were warnings with no content ("we cannot check if they are true"): the planner was told the plan "must not spread its claims".
change_log.change: Only a scam (asks for money, codes, details, secrecy) becomes a warning without its asks. Misleading or unverified: explain what it shows and says as the speaker's claims, and name the untrue ones.

change_log.weakness: A video made with a note repeated the note scene by scene ("heavy machinery for a nothing-to-do message").
change_log.change: Each maker is told which moments are made with it and to do its own format's job.

change_log.weakness: Pictures drew a generic older woman listening at home instead of the reel's subject ("invents a scene that is not in the reel").
change_log.change: Draw what the item is about (its place, the movement, the thing), not the parent or someone watching.

change_log.weakness: One share made one to three moments, while the product promises (home page, "Share a reel. Get a conversation.") a mind map, slides, a quiz, an animated video and a picture from one reel.
change_log.change: Every share makes the full set: the shape's moment leads (card, steps, video or map; else the planner's first), then map, slides, quiz, video and picture; a child's set is story, quiz game, video, map, picture.

change_log.weakness: Keeping the substance (C2) cost clarity: clear fell from 4.41 to 3.97 (six film titles in one sentence); "he says" for speakers of unknown gender; pages that only say Maya loves her.
change_log.change: One fact per sentence, at most 12 words, list items on their own lines; "the reel says" unless the speaker is known; every line carries content.

change_log.weakness: Slides for a list or a topic read as fake steps ("these are not steps Linda can follow"), and the last page was filler ("Ask Maya For Help").
change_log.change: Slides: one idea per page in order; a method's step, a list's item or a topic's part, named; the last page is the one thing to remember or do.

change_log.weakness: Quizzes asked trivial or sharing questions with absurd wrong answers ("a kids cartoon show").
change_log.change: Ask about the content's own facts; wrong choices sound possible; the explanation adds one fact.

change_log.weakness: Maps organised the conversation, not the content (branches "Hello from Maya", "Fun Reel Question"), with telegraphic leaves (map mean 2.8).
change_log.change: Branches are the content's own parts (items, steps, groups, claims, by name); a leaf is a 4-10 word phrase that tells one fact.

change_log.weakness: The last scene was "Maya can help" filler.
change_log.change: The last scene is the one thing to remember or do.

change_log.weakness: In the lab a picture was only its description, while the Studio draws it.
change_log.change: The lab draws every picture with Muse Image ($0.01), as the Studio does; /lab shows them.

change_log.weakness: A quiz marked the reel's false claim ("a free iPhone and Android app") as the right answer while its own explanation said it was source code you build with a paid key.
change_log.change: Code checks that each question's explanation matches its marked choice better than any other; if not, the maker gets one more try, told what was wrong (the same check catches an empty moment).

change_log.weakness: Pictures still drew generic cosy rooms and parks (picture mean 3.2, the lowest): the ban on screens and text left nothing of a film or app reel to draw.
change_log.change: Show the subject concretely: the movement from the side, the named things (a phone recording, a cinema seat facing a glowing blank screen, a shop shelf), or the place; no readable text, no real faces.

change_log.where: studio/agents.py WATCHER, studio/swarm.py watch, content/ingest.py video_part
change_log.weakness: The reader saw 8 evenly spread frames, so it merged movements and lost their order ("links one move to two benefits"; "cannot show the timing or mouth shape").
change_log.change: Muse Spark watches the whole video with its sound (input_video; tested: it gave each step of an exercise video with its time and purpose) and returns a timeline the reader uses.

change_log.weakness: Stills were spread evenly, so a video scene often showed the wrong moment for its words.
change_log.change: The stills are taken in the middle of each step the watcher found (up to 8), so scene N shows step N.

change_log.weakness: Film and website lists gave bare names ("titles with no hint of what each film is like").
change_log.change: A new agent looks up each named film, show, book, site, app, product, place or course on the web (genre, year, rating; free or paid) and the makers say what each one is.

change_log.weakness: In a movement still, an older reader may not see which part moves.
change_log.change: SAM 3.1 finds the body part the watcher names in each still; the video centres on it and rings it.

change_log.weakness: A reel shared as a link could not be opened, so the caregiver had to save and attach the video.
change_log.change: Reel and video links (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook) are downloaded with their caption, through those sites' extractors only; photo posts and login-only reels get a plain message. Tested on 11 links.

change_log.weakness: With films now looked up (C24), the safety review held 8 of Leo's 41 sets (3 before): sets offered PG-13 and R films, kept handstand steps, or told him to "follow for part two".
change_log.change: A child's moments leave out anything rated for teens or adults, never give the steps of a stunt, and never ask him to follow or subscribe. Re-run on the 8 held reels.

change_log.weakness: The lab's calls, copied into the app's usage ledger for the credit meter, pushed it past the demo's $25 spend guard, so the Studio refused new shares.
change_log.change: Lab rows are marked "source": "lab"; the credit meter counts them, the demo's guard doesn't (and reads the app's own ledger, so tests no longer depend on the real one).

change_log.weakness: The family read the moments and found them robotic: "Mom, I am Maya, and I saved this for you. The reel says...", the speaker's coat and the black-and-white picture, "you do not need to follow or comment". Earlier rules caused part of it (C13 told makers to write "the reel says").
change_log.change: The family's own voice: pick up the chat, never introduce yourself, tell the content itself as news or a tip, name a person only when it matters, no disclaimers she doesn't need, a scam as kind news, products with what they're good for and an offer to get one.

change_log.weakness: A rule in a prompt is followed most of the time, not always.
change_log.change: Code finds the robotic habits in what she will see (English and Japanese) and gives the maker one rewrite, told exactly which words to change; the version with fewer habits is kept.

change_log.weakness: Every kind of reel got the same treatment: ten films listed, a song quote with no hook, tech jargon, stunts explained as a lecture.
change_log.change: A playbook by kind: films that suit her with an offer to watch together; products; recipes; tips as steps; a quote or song with the hook she knows ("Remember this song?"); tech told lightly; stunts to watch; scams as news; the question always about her own life. Safety notes only for a real risk.

change_log.weakness: Clickbait ("comment RSA for the link", "$850,000 course") was listed as a scam sign, so a real free Stanford class got a scam warning and no link.
change_log.change: Only asks for money, codes, details, secrecy, impersonation or a risky download are scam signs; the real thing is judged, not the hook. Checked official links are added by code for anything without scam signs.

change_log.where: studio/inputs.py page_image, studio/swarm.py product_pictures and product_crops
change_log.weakness: A product reel said "only her opinion, you do not need to buy anything" and never named what each product is for; a background song was looked up as a product.
change_log.change: Products named with what they're good for, a picture from the shop's own page (og:image, fetched with the same guards as links) or cut out of the reel's still by SAM 3.1, and "I'd like one" on her phone; the item researcher corrects an item's kind (a song is a song).

change_log.where: studio/agents.py maker rules, mind map maker
change_log.weakness: After round 6 the voice was warm but some moments still read like lists: "Not for us" after each of five films, mind map leaves as labels (natural 3 of 5 on maps). The user: "close to natural, how we explain something to others".
change_log.change: Explain it like over tea: why she'd care ("you know how ..." from her life), the gist, one or two details with a comparison she knows; contractions, a little reaction of your own; say once that something isn't for her; mind map leaves are short spoken sentences.

change_log.weakness: Round 7 still had "not for us" after each of five films on one card, and a video line about the speaker's blue shirt: habits the first check didn't know.
change_log.change: The check also catches a refusal repeated after each item and describing the person in the reel (clothes, "he makes funny faces"); 5% of round 6-7 moments would now get the rewrite. Not yet measured in a round.

change_log.weakness: No score measured what the family complained about.
change_log.change: Judge v4 adds natural (1-5: the family talking vs a report) and counts each robotic habit as a problem; round 5 was scored again with it.

change_log.weakness: With a full set, "format fit" as "is this the best format" marks every map, quiz and picture down by design.
change_log.change: Judge v3: format fit asks whether the moment uses its own format well; slides are one idea per slide. Round 3 was scored again with it, so round 4 compares like for like.

change_log.weakness: Untested: the same reels as a child's set (story, quiz game, video, map, picture) for Leo, 9.
change_log.change: A children's round with the child-safety review on every pack and a children's judge (safety first).

change_log.weakness: The judge marked right things as faults: a note in Maya's voice as an invented speaker, a picture judged on its caption alone, a watch-only framing of a risky exercise as missing content.
change_log.change: Judge v2 is told how moments work; round 1 was scored again with it, so every round compares like for like.

change_log.weakness: Transcript agreement was near 0 for Hindi and Urdu reels because the reference was in another script (Urdu script, or an English translation) while ours was in Devanagari.
change_log.change: Agreement is measured only when both transcripts use the same writing system; otherwise not comparable.

change_log.weakness: Only the 25 most recently edited pages were listed, so the agent could not find older reel pages (2 of 10 scenarios failed).
change_log.change: Follow Notion's result pages up to the limit asked for (at most 200).

change_log.weakness: Text inside toggles was never read, and a database row's properties were ignored (1 scenario failed).
change_log.change: Read nested blocks two levels down, follow block pagination, and put a row's properties first.

change_log.weakness: Asked about one reel, the answerer used two other film pages that looked related.
change_log.change: Answer about the thing asked, not a near match; otherwise it isn't found.
